CustomField.description: What this row's problem has in common with other rows: the dealer, each firm or fund issue and the spelling it is about (plus the rep code when the right answer can differ by code, as for a missing or ambiguous name). Set by matching for rows waiting for review; blank for roster rows, code issues and rows not in review. Trade Review shows rows with the same key as one line with their count and total, and a decision on it applies to all of them. Indexed (External ID, not unique) so the rows sharing a key are found quickly. Keys over 255 characters are stored as a SHA-256 hash.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Rows with the same issue key share the same problem and are decided together in Trade Review. Set by the system.
CustomField.label: Issue Key
